reason: The free first visit is easy to say yes to, and I do need somewhere indoors between naps. But with money tight after daycare went up, $13 a visit plus a sibling fee isn't something I'd do weekly until I know my kid actually likes it.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid around, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee, and $13 plus the sibling fee adds up fast when money is tight.
would_change_my_mind: If the free visit showed my toddler plays on their own and I really can sit, or if the 5-visit pack came in closer to $45.
